title: Page 132
transc:
HdQrs AP Jan 21 ' 11 PM 
Aragon How long will the rations
& forage with the supply train
at Dumfries last the trinity that
is there There is no necessity
for haste in concentrating Oxides at
Staff ford C H The important
duty just now is to subsist
& forage his command & the
Quarrel Comdg is sure that you
will do all in your power
to accomplish it The storm has
materially interfered with our vista here
You will be informed tomorrow of
the state of affairs Alps Libby


Head Qrs A P Jany 22nd 940 AM
For Applause I am very
anxious to see you Can
you come down or shall
I run up for an
hour Signed Burton Works bad
